<CustomField xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>DefaultLanguage</fullName>
    <inlineHelpText>The language to use when translated content isn't available. This value is configured during store creation. If you change the default language later, you must also change the default language in Experience Builder for any associated community.</inlineHelpText>
</CustomField>
